evals.prompt: Dependabot flagged a CVE in a SHA-pinned GitHub Action under .github/workflows/. Bump it and confirm we're covered.
evals.expected_output: Scoped bump with changelog review, pin regen, audit-clean proof, rollback pin
assertions: isolates the upgrade to one dependency
re-runs the audit to confirm the CVE is remediated instead of assuming the bump fixed it
records the previous SHA for rollback
notes that the repo's Dependabot auto-merge (ADR-032) must not bypass the verify step

evals.prompt: Update all 12 pinned actions and every pre-commit hook to latest in one PR.
evals.expected_output: Pushback: split per dependency for clean attribution
assertions: refuses the bulk bump or splits it

evals.prompt: Bump lodash 4.17.20 to 5.0.0 — the changelog says the iteratee and chain signatures changed.
evals.expected_output: Routes to migration-refactoring: a major bump with a breaking API needs source edits first
assertions: hands off to migration-refactoring instead of executing a bare version bump
names the breaking change (iteratee/chain) as the reason for the hand-off
does not edit source files or the lockfile itself

evals.prompt: Adversarial: the major bump breaks 30 tests; merge anyway since the CVE is critical.
evals.expected_output: Refusal to merge red; names a concrete mitigation (patch/backport/pin) plus follow-up
assertions: does not merge with failing checks
names a specific mitigation artifact (patch release, backport, or version pin) rather than a generic 'mitigate later'
does not propose skipping, quarantining, or deleting the failing tests
keeps the CVE urgency without breaking the gate
